verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a data-export feature, open-format export, or offboarding path. The REST API ([netlify-docs-14]) is described only as managing sites, deploys, and DNS, not as exporting data. Managed Postgres and file storage ([netlify-docs-13], [netlify-docs-23]) are mentioned without any export or portability details, and the axis clearly applies to a hosting platform.
